study_identification_part.si_4_title: Judged by your neighbors: A novel framework for personalized assessment of brain structural aging effects in diverse populations

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Nearest Neighbor Normativity (N ³) uses local density estimation with a Nearest-Neighbor algorithm.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: The N ³ approach is based on local density estimation in tailored control groups. To establish a normative reference for the local density seen in a representative sample, we here use the simple and intuitive Nearest-Neighbor algorithm [25, 32].

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Global brain structural volumes: GM, WM, WMH, TIV, and CSF.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: Our analysis focuses on gray matter (GM), white matter (WM), hyperintense white matter (WMH), total intracranial volume (TIV) and cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) volumes.

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Normative reference is stratified by age and sex (same-aged females or males).
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: we stratify the training sample by sex and age, resulting into 100 control groups containing same-aged females or males (22 to 72 years), respectively.
